syria-2024.notes: Wrong edition: the Joomla site syria.acm-acpc.org in this capture is SCPC 2011 (rules, schedule 28/9/2011 to 1/10/2011, contest environment, a results page with 12 teams A-H headed 'SCPC 2011 result', gallery). It probably belongs to syria-2011 (id guessed). The facebook.com addresses captured are generic Facebook login/sign-up pages, not the acm.scpc page; two other captured addresses are an H-Sphere default server page and an error page. No 2024 content. Needs a new capture for 2024.

sources.evidence: The pages of syria.acm-acpc.org in our copy are the site of the First National Syrian Collegiate Programming Contest (SCPC 2011, 28 Sep to 1 Oct, Tishreen University, Latakia), and the Facebook addresses hold only generic Facebook sign-up pages; nothing mentions 2024.
